language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello my name is Vincent and I live in this magical castle in the clouds. It is quite big. To tell you how big the castle actually is, I will have to find out the area.
Area is a unit that tells us the size of two-dimensional shapes or figures. To find out the area of my castle, I have to multiply length by width.
As you can see it is 50 metres in length and 40 metres in width. So the ground area is 2000 square meters!
Let's get started with the things I want to do today.
Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello my name is Vincent and I live in this magical castle in the clouds. It is quite big. To tell you how big the castle actually is, I will have to find out the area.
Area is a unit that tells us the size of two-dimensional shapes or figures. To find out the area of my castle, I have to multiply length by width.
As you can see it is 50 metres in length and 40 metres in width. So the ground area is 2000 square meters!
Let's get started with the things I want to do today.
My room is on the fifth floor. Let's take a look at the plan I’ve drawn.

On the left you can see my room. My room is 200 times bigger than on the map. Can you see the scale? 1:200 means 1 cm on the map equals 200 cm (or 2 m) in reality. So if a room is 4 cm long on the map, it is actually 8 m.
Can you help me calculate the perimeter of each room on the map by using the scale?
